eventsTimeline.mode.label: Timeline display
lifeline.empty: No dated event: there is nothing to show on the chart.
lifeline.instructions: Mouse: drag to pan the chart, Ctrl and wheel to zoom. Keyboard: left and right arrows to pan, plus and minus to zoom, zero to show everything. Tab to enter the events, arrow keys to move between them, Enter to select the person.
lifeline.legend.imprecise: Imprecise date (hatched range: about, before, after, between)
